statement: Build a single-file, mobile-first website for Thread & Loom, a handloom clothing boutique in Pune, where visitors can browse products by category, filter by size and price, read the size guide, see new arrivals, order on WhatsApp, view a lookbook, find the shop, and read the exchange policy and reviews.
audience: Shoppers in and around Pune, mostly on phones, looking for handloom kurtas, sarees, cotton shirts and dupattas.
standards: Earthy and elegant look: muted natural colours, refined type, generous spacing.
Works well on phones: usable at 360px wide and at 1280px wide.
Plain HTML, CSS and JavaScript in one file; CDN libraries allowed; no build step.
Prices shown in rupees exactly as supplied; no invented facts.
rules: Use only the products, sizes, prices, contact details, policies and reviews the Requester supplied.
No product is shown as on sale, because none were named.
Product and outfit pictures are placeholder visuals, because no photos were supplied.
Sarees and dupattas are free size; kurtas and shirts use the sizes supplied per item.
Orders go through WhatsApp only, with the product name and chosen size in the message.
done_when: The page shows the name Thread & Loom and Pune, has a viewport meta tag, and uses an earthy colour palette defined in the CSS.

The site lists exactly these 10 products with their prices: Indigo block-print kurta 1,499; Mustard handloom kurta 1,699; White chikankari kurta 2,199; Ikat handloom saree 3,499; Khadi silk saree 4,999; Cotton jamdani saree 3,999; Khadi cotton shirt 1,299; Linen-blend shirt 1,599; Block-print dupatta 899; Chanderi dupatta 1,099.
Visitors can filter products by category (All, Kurtas, Sarees, Shirts, Dupattas), by size, and by price, and the filters work together.

Size options match the supplied data: Indigo block-print kurta S to XXL; Mustard handloom kurta S to XL; White chikankari kurta XS to XL; Khadi cotton shirt S to XXL; Linen-blend shirt M to XXL; all sarees and dupattas Free size.
A size guide table shows chest in inches: XS 32, S 34, M 36, L 38, XL 40, XXL 42.
A New Arrivals section shows exactly the White chikankari kurta, Ikat handloom saree and Linen-blend shirt.
Every product has an order button that opens a WhatsApp link to 910000011111 with the product name and chosen size in the message text.
A lookbook section shows 3 styled outfits, each built only from the listed products and naming them.
A store section shows 18 FC Road, Shivajinagar, Pune 411005; hours 11am to 9pm, Tuesday to Sunday, closed Monday; shop phone +91 00000 22222; and a map link for the address.
A policy section states: exchange within 7 days if unworn with tags; no returns on sale items; and delivery in Pune in 2 days for Rs 79, free above 2,999, pay on delivery.
A reviews section shows these three reviews: "Beautiful fabric, fits perfectly" - Meera K.; "Fast delivery and lovely packing" - Arjun S.; "My go-to for festive kurtas" - Priya D.
The page has no JavaScript errors, no horizontal overflow at 360px or 1280px, and no broken in-page links.
visitor_needs: See styled outfits in a lookbook
Read the return and exchange policy
